description.narrative:
The Danish Government has decided to continue the core contribution to ICARS for the period 2026 – 2030, in line with ICARS new strategic period. As part of the continued Danish support, it was also agreed that the future grant to the organization should be transitioned from the Ministry of the Interior and Health to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Denmark.
Consequently, the financial support and the grant management will from the 1 January 2026 be with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
In order to ensure a gradual and smooth transition between the two ministries and to align with the upcoming ICARS strategy for 2026 – 2030, which will be launched in May 2026 it was agreed to formulate an interim programme covering the period from 1 January 2026 – 30 June 2026 (this programme).
During this interim grant period the Ministry of Foreign Affairs will in collaboration with the Ministry for the Interior and Health as well as the Ministry for Food, Agriculture and Fishery formulate a new multi-year and more comprehensive programme, aligned with the new ICARS strategy for the period 2026 – 2030, with Danish key priorities for the continued engagement with ICARS.
